# Indiana Tube Corporation

> Indiana Tube Corporation (ITC) engineers precision welded steel tubing for automotive, oil & gas, HVAC, heavy equipment, and hardware/structural industries. 45+ years of manufacturing experience based in Evansville, Indiana.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of ITC's precision steel tubing capabilities and industries served.
- [Industries](/industries): Automotive, oil & gas, HVAC, heavy equipment, and hardware/structural applications.
- [Products](/products): Product line details, dimensions, coatings (including Galfan®), and specifications.
- [About](/about): Company history, leadership team, and parent company Steel Partners.
- [Downloads](/downloads): Product data sheets, certifications, and technical documents.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales contact information, phone, email, and Evansville facility address.
- [Quote](/quote): Request a custom tubing quote — dimensions, volume, and industry inquiry form.
- [Employee News](/employee-news): Company announcements, achievements, and timeline for employees.
